g1.label: 1 — already great ___
g1.why: They had only just met, so “friends” is the word that fits; relatives are family and strangers are people you do not know.

g2.label: 2 — walk around in a tour ___
g2.why: A tour group is the fixed phrase for people who travel together with a guide.

g3.label: 3 — an Australian ___
g3.why: An accent is the way somebody sounds when they speak; an accident is something that goes wrong.

g4.label: 4 — called an air ___
g4.why: An air ambulance is a plane or helicopter that takes injured people to hospital.

g5.label: 5 — I’m a bit ___ of box jellyfish
g5.why: You are scared of something; the thing itself is scary.

g6.label: 6 — the area that has been netted ___
g6.why: To net off an area means to close it with a net so nothing can swim in.

g7.label: 7 — it’s much more ___ that
g7.why: Likely means probable; likeable means easy to like and alike means similar.

g8.label: 8 — some of them are never ___ again
g8.why: After “are” the passive needs the past participle “seen”, not “see” or “saw”.

g1.label: 1 — a student ___ since Thursday
g1.why: “Since Thursday” reaches up to now, so use the present perfect passive: has/have + been + seen.

g2.label: 2 — his mobile phone ___ on Friday morning
g2.why: A finished action at a stated past time takes the simple past passive: was + found.

g3.label: 3 — his parents ___
g3.why: No past time is given and the news still matters now, so the present perfect passive fits; “have informed” is active.

g4.label: 4 — the search ___ every evening at sunset
g4.why: “Every evening” marks a repeated routine, so use the simple present passive.

g5.label: 5 — thousands of tourists ___ by bushwalking
g5.why: “Every year” signals something that happens regularly, so the simple present passive is right.

g6.label: 6 — last month an 18-year-old ___ alive
g6.why: “Last month” is a finished past time, so the simple past passive is needed.

g7.label: 7 — unless you ___ survival training
g7.why: The training happens before the trip and leads up to it, so the present perfect passive fits.

g8.label: 8 — so far no trace ___
g8.why: “So far” means up to now, which is the present perfect; the passive adds been + discovered.

g1.label: 1 — he ___ since Thursday
g1.why: The active is present perfect (has seen), so the passive is has been seen — here in the negative.

g2.label: 2 — Jim ___ not to go off alone
g2.why: The active is past perfect (had warned), so the passive keeps had and adds been + warned.

g3.label: 3 — he ___ that it was safe
g3.why: The active is simple past (told), so the passive is was + told.

g4.label: 4 — this guy ___
g4.why: After will the passive is be + past participle: will be rescued.

g5.correct: isn’t going to be called off
accept: isn’t going to be called off
g5.label: 5 — the search ___
g5.why: With going to, the passive is going to be + past participle.

g6.label: 6 — he ___ by a snake
g6.why: The active is simple past negative (didn’t bite), so the passive is wasn’t + bitten.

g7.label: 7 — we ___ the camera at the hostel (past perfect)
g7.why: Leaving the camera happened before we tried to take the photo, so it takes the past perfect — as in the Outback unit.

g8.label: 8 — Mike advised Jim ___ alone (infinitive)
g8.why: “Advise somebody to do something” takes the infinitive, and the negative goes in front of it — as in the Ireland unit.

g1.label: 1 — would like ___ a room with a harbour view
g1.why: After would like the passive infinitive is to be + past participle.

g2.label: 2 — expect ___ around the city
g2.why: Expect takes the full infinitive, so the passive is to be shown, not just be shown.

g3.label: 3 — hope ___ to a barbecue
g3.why: After to be you need the past participle taken, never the -ing form.

g4.label: 4 — want ___ breakfast on the terrace
g4.why: The guests receive the breakfast, so want takes the passive infinitive to be served.

g5.label: 5 — want ___ up for their flight
g5.why: The past participle of wake is woken, so the passive infinitive is to be woken.

g6.label: 6 — hopes ___ about any parties
g6.why: He receives the information, so hope takes to be told; to be telling is not a passive form.

g7.label: 7 — dangerous animals ___ in Australia
g7.why: After a modal verb the passive is be + past participle: can be found, not can be find.

g8.label: 8 — not all the stories ___
g8.why: After should the passive is be + past participle; “should been” is never possible.
